# Alamy

> > Alamy is a global stock photography marketplace connecting contributors with customers through authentic imagery, vectors, and editorial content.

Alamy provides photographers, illustrators, and news agencies with tools like Alamy Image Manager to upload, license, and monetize their content. The platform supports multiple file formats (JPEG, TIFF, EPS) and offers FTP upload via clients like FileZilla, WinSCP, and Cyberduck for efficient content management.

## Key Topics

- Stock photography marketplace
- Image licensing (commercial and editorial)
- Alamy Image Manager
- FTP upload (FileZilla, WinSCP, Cyberduck)
- Quality control and image keywording
- Model and property releases
- Vector submission (EPS, JPEG formats)
- Contributor commission structure
- File requirements (RGB, resolution, formats)
- Alamy Live News editorial photography
- Authentic content monetization
- Student photographer program
- Boolean search and advanced filters
